doc_title_en: Notice regarding the Results of Public Tender Offer on Anshin Guarantor Shares by Muninova Holdings and the Changes in Parent Company, Other Related Companies, Principal Shareholders and Top Shareholder
doc_title_jp: 公開買付けの結果並びに親会社、その他の関係会社、主要株主及び主要株主である筆頭株主の異動に関するお知らせ

key_facts.method: public tender offer + concurrent dividend in kind

summary_en: Public tender offer by Muninova Holdings completed 2026-07-02. 7,100,712 shares tendered (minimum threshold 5,186,700 met). Concurrent acquisition of 6,408,000 Anshin Guarantor shares held by Aiful via dividend in kind on settlement date 2026-07-09. Post-settlement, Muninova to hold >50% voting rights and become parent company; Aiful to cease being material shareholder.
summary_jp: ムニノバホールディングスの公開買付2026年7月2日終了。応募7,100,712株（下限5,186,700株以上で成立）。決済日2026年7月9日にアイフルからの現物配当により6,408,000株同時取得。決済後ムニノバの議決権50%超、親会社化へ。
